model: INMBSSAM001R100 Samsung NASA AC to Modbus RTU gateway
applies_to: Samsung NASA-protocol commercial indoor units on the remote-controller bus, user's manual r1.4 (01/2024).
summary: Newer Intesis Modbus RTU server for Samsung NASA commercial units. Holding registers cover on/off, mode, fan (incl. turbo), both vanes, setpoint, external temperature, window contact, filter status and reset, alarm and error code, return-air temperature and selection of which indoor unit on the bus is reported.

addressing.note: Tables give a 'protocol address' (base 0) and a 'PLC address' (base 1); the protocol address is the wire address and is used for 'documented'.

source.title: Intesis INMBSSAM001R100 (Samsung NASA) Modbus RTU (EIA-485) Interface for Samsung air conditioners - User's Manual
source.pages: pp. 8-11 (registers), pp. 12-13 (temperature notes), pp. 14-17 (DIP switches, functions)

notes: The manual calls every register '16-bit unsigned', but it prints negative temperature ranges (temperature reference -41..38 °C) and the -32768 (0x8000) no-value marker, so temperature registers are mapped as signed INT16 here; all other registers are UINT16.

Temperatures follow SW4: x1 °C, x10 °C or °F. The register footnote calls x10 the default but the DIP-switch table marks x1 and Celsius as factory setting, so scale 1 / °C is used; with x10 set use 0.1.
The external temperature written to register 22 is passed to the remote-controller bus; the indoor unit must be set to use the remote-controller sensor for it to take effect.
FC16 is accepted only with a length of 1 register.
Error code list not reproduced; see manual section 7.

registers.description: Available modes depend on the indoor unit.

registers.name: AC unit fan speed
registers.description: Available speeds depend on the indoor unit.

registers.name: AC unit temperature setpoint
registers.description: Cool 18..30 °C, heat 16..30 °C. SW4 x1 °C assumed (x10: 0.1, or °F).

registers.name: AC unit temperature reference
registers.description: -41..38 °C; control temperature. SW4 x1 °C assumed (x10: 0.1, or °F).

registers.name: Window contact
registers.description: Virtual window contact written from Modbus.

registers.name: Gateway disablement
registers.description: Non-volatile.

registers.name: AC remote control disablement
registers.description: Non-volatile.

registers.name: AC unit operation time
registers.description: Hours in On state, 0..65535. Non-volatile.

registers.name: Error code
registers.description: Samsung error code; see manual section 7.

values.65535: Gateway cannot talk to the indoor unit (-1)

registers.name: Open Window switch-off timeout
registers.description: Minutes from window open to unit off, 0..30 (default 30).

registers.name: Modbus RTU baud rate
registers.description: Rate set on SW3/SW4 (2400..115200, default 9600).

registers.name: Modbus slave address
registers.description: Address set on SW3, 1..63.

registers.name: External ambient temperature (from Modbus)
registers.description: Sent to the RC bus; 0x8000 = none. SW4 x1 °C assumed (x10: 0.1, or °F).

registers.name: AC real temperature setpoint
registers.description: Setpoint used by the unit, 16..31 °C. SW4 x1 °C assumed (x10: 0.1, or °F).

registers.name: Window contact on/off disablement
registers.description: Shows whether the window contact is currently blocking on/off.

registers.name: Device ID
registers.description: Reads 0x2E00.

registers.name: Return path temperature
registers.description: Return-air sensor. SW4 x1 °C assumed (x10: 0.1, or °F).

registers.name: Number of indoor units connected
registers.description: Units on the same RC bus.

registers.name: Internal IU address
registers.description: Position in the gateway's sorted list of the unit whose status is shown.

registers.name: IU address status reported
registers.description: Address of the indoor unit whose status is reported.

registers.name: Block periodic sendings
registers.description: Blocked = only changed values are forwarded. Firmware 0.1+.

integration.summary: Write 0-4 for control and poll 5, 10, 11, 44 and 66. With several indoor units on one RC bus, use 68/69 to see which unit's status is being reported.
integration.enable: No enable step; register 7 = 1 disables the gateway.
quirks: Temperatures can be negative; read them as signed.
setup: 9600 baud 8N2 default (8N1 auto-detected); baud on SW3/SW4.
gotchas: The external temperature only drives the unit if the Samsung unit is configured to use the remote-controller sensor.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
